assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create one tiny roguelike DOWNWARD STAIRCASE game tile. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the existing 32x32 Dungeon Crawl staircase, use its square dark recessed opening, visible descending diagonal treads, readable black outline and small grid-compatible footprint as the structural guide. Image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: HoloHome cream mansion, indigo roof, mint cyan trim and small gold accents. Change the staircase material to cream stone frame, muted indigo descending steps and cyan trim; a tiny pale cyan triangle inset on one corner of the frame. Preserve the very obvious DOWNWARD square pit silhouette and large dark opening. No handrails, no roof, no tall arch, no floating icon, no arrows, no glow cloud, no text. It must fit within a SINGLE 32x32 pixel game tile, front-facing oblique top-down DCSS orthographic projection. Chunky true low resolution pixel art, about 24 colors, crisp single-pixel dark contour, no anti-aliasing, transparent background, 2 native pixels transparent margin. Show only this one staircase isolated and enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixel edges. Keep 4-5 clearly separated thick treads, do not replace it with upward stairs.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one HoloHome entrance portal sprite for a 32px-grid top-down roguelike, final footprint 96px wide by 64px tall (3x2 tiles), transparent background. Reference image 1 is style reference only: the HoloHome front entrance. Reinterpret only the central doorway, no whole building, no roof silhouette or side towers. Cream stone side pillars, slightly arched indigo-blue lintel edged in muted gold, mint cyan inset accents, a tiny cyan triangular flag and small dark blue plaque reading exactly 'HOLO HOME' in simple tiny gold capitals. WIDE OPEN center doorway, fully transparent empty opening, dark outlined cream jambs at both sides. Orthographic front-facing slightly top-down Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup pixel-art perspective, chunky 24-color pixel clusters, clear black outlines, no smooth gradients or anti-aliasing. Comfortable recognizable mansion entry that is faintly aged and scuffed, no horror grime. Flat level base, small transparent margins on every side. One isolated portal, not a diorama, no characters, no floor patch. Keep the open passage one tile wide in the middle.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one 64x32 native pixel-art sofa for a 32px-grid roguelike, transparent background. A cozy two-seat lounge sofa belonging to HoloHome: pale cream upholstery, muted mint teal cushions, warm walnut wood feet, restrained brass piping. Viewed front-facing from the high orthographic slightly top-down camera used by Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup furniture. Very legible seat, backrest, two cushions and armrests; final object about two tiles wide and one tile deep. True chunky 24-color pixel art, dark one-pixel contour, distinct pixel clusters, no smooth shading, no fuzzy edges, no anti-aliasing. No people, no floor, no large shadow, no text, no extra furniture. Slight wear on wood but warm and inviting, isolated single sofa with transparent outer margins. The style reference image shows HoloHome's cream and warm wood interior, not an edit target.
